title: Musher Blueprint Document
description: A composition of one or more components into a single deployable application.
$comment: Structural and type validation only — cross-document reference resolution, slug/directory agreement, and platform capability checks are separate validation layers. See spec.md.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be BLUEPRINT.

specVersion.description: Version of the Musher specification this document is written against.

BlueprintComputeConstraints.$comment: Every term pin is a lowercase token rather than a member of a closed set: the grammar is fixed by this contract, the vocabularies are not published anywhere yet, and spec.md §4.4 records that as a gap. cpuDedication is the exception — two values are the whole concept.
BlueprintComputeConstraints.description: Advanced, optional compute pins that narrow the hosts a node may be placed on. A pin never changes the compute the node's size names. See spec.md §4.4.

acceleratorInterconnect.description: Required accelerator interconnect, such as nvlink or pcie. Omit to pin nothing. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

acceleratorRuntimes.description: Required accelerator runtimes, such as cuda. An empty array pins nothing, and a term may not repeat. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

acceleratorSKUClass.description: Exact accelerator SKU class to pin. Omit to pin nothing. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

cpuArchitectures.description: Permitted CPU architectures, such as x86_64 or arm64. An empty array pins nothing, and a term may not repeat. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

cpuDedication.description: Whether the node's vCPU must be dedicated rather than shared. Omit to pin nothing. This is the one pin whose vocabulary this contract closes — see spec.md §4.4.

minAcceleratorMemoryGiB.description: Minimum accelerator VRAM in GiB. Omit to pin no floor.

minStorageIOPS.description: Minimum provisioned IOPS. Omit to pin no floor.

networkClass.description: Required network class. Omit to pin nothing. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

storageClass.description: Required storage class, such as local-nvme. Omit to pin nothing. The permitted terms are not a vocabulary this contract defines — see spec.md §4.4.

BlueprintMetadata.description: Identity block of a blueprint document. The blueprint carries the item's revision; its sibling listing carries none. See spec.md §3.

revision.description: Item revision — the position of this release in the catalog item's lineage. Orders releases and nothing more.

slug.description: Item slug — must equal the item's directory name.

allOf.$comment: spec.md §4.1. The form of `componentRef` decides whether a revision is required: a reference beginning ./ or ../ names a document whose own metadata.revision is the version deployed, so a second one here could contradict it. Moved into this allOf so the node two independent conditionals read as siblings — the reference form says nothing about compute, which is what the branch below is about, and externality is not a property of the reference form: a published reference names an external component as readily as a repo-local one does.

spec.md §4.3 and §4.4. `size: null` is a node that runs no compute, which is the one thing a three-segment profile slug cannot say. A placement pin narrows the hosts a node may be placed on, and a node placed on none has nothing for one to narrow — so a pin is rejected rather than ignored, which is the rule component §5 states for a forbidden field.

componentRef.$comment: Both patterns are lookahead-free so they compile under RE2 as well as ECMA-262. A path segment must begin with a letter or digit, which is how `.` and `..` are excluded as interior segments without a negative lookahead; that leaves one spelling per target and keeps the containment check in the semantic phase from having to normalise first.
componentRef.description: Reference to the component document this node deploys, in one of two forms. A repo-local reference begins ./ or ../ and ends .yaml or .yml, and resolves relative to the directory holding this blueprint document; its version is the referenced document's metadata.revision. A published reference is the component's UUID, which names the component across all its revisions, and requires revision to select the one deployed. The relative-path prefix is what tells the two apart — a bare slug is not distinguishable from a UUID.

placement.description: Optional placement compute pins that narrow the eligible-host set at schedule time. Absent and a block with no pin set mean the same thing. See spec.md §4.4.

revision.description: Lineage version pinned by a published reference. Required on a published reference and rejected on a repo-local one, where the referenced document's own metadata.revision supplies it.

size.$comment: Lookahead-free, so it compiles under RE2 as well as ECMA-262. Only the grammar is here; membership is a capability check (spec.md §4.3). `null` is the spelling for a node that runs no compute, and it is the third placement ADR 0007 §5 leaves a field nullable: it says something omission does not, so the field stays REQUIRED and an author records deliberately-none rather than leaving it out.
size.description: Compute Profile slug bound to this node, in family.tier.size form — for example general.standard.small — or null where the node deploys a component this platform does not run and there is no compute to name. Required either way, because a component document carries no compute of its own. The profiles actually on offer are published at https://api.musher.dev/v1/reference/compute-profiles.

bindings.description: Explicit input suppliers keyed by receiving input name.

exposure.description: Endpoint exposure; omitted endpoint entries are PRIVATE.

BlueprintParameter.description: Named installation value, explicitly bound by consuming nodes.

default.description: Logical default, overridable by a submitted value. No interpolation.

generator.description: Persisted credential generation; submitted overrides are forbidden.

BlueprintParameter.$comment: The selected branch requires its applicable fields and forbids fields that have no meaning for that branch.

byteLength.description: Number of random bytes generated for the value.

encoding.description: Encoding applied to securely generated random bytes.

BlueprintParameterUi.$comment: spec.md §5.3. The control is derived from the covered inputs' schema rather than declared, so this carries only what a derivation cannot supply.
BlueprintParameterUi.description: Presentation metadata for an install-form parameter.

enumLabels.description: Human-readable label for each enum member, keyed by the member it names. A member left unlabelled is offered as it is spelled.

examples.description: Example values illustrating the form a value takes. Never submitted — a value that is actually submitted is schema.default.

label.description: Human-readable label shown on the install form.

order.description: Relative position of the field within the form. Lower sorts first; a parameter declaring no order sorts after every parameter that declares one.

prominence.description: Standing of the field in the form: PRIMARY is offered directly, SECONDARY behind a disclosure the deploying user opens.

BlueprintSpec.description: Composition, explicit input suppliers, allocation and installation parameters.

parameters.description: Named installation values; no implicit binding by name.

source.description: One whole config reference, for example ${{ config.llm.baseUrl }}. Authorized at installation.

allOf.$comment: External components have no image, source commit or compute allocation.
External components allocate neither storage nor public exposure.
Git builds pin the source commit as well as the built image digest.
